modalities.evidence: expert contours of up to twenty-nine structures in DICOM RTSS format

output.population: 359 pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis or abdomen-pelvis exams acquired from three CT scanners, representing random pediatric cases based upon routine clinical indications.
output.summary: Pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis and abdomen-pelvis CT exams in DICOM format with expert organ contours, collected to support development of rapid, patient-specific CT organ dose estimation tools.
